proof: The retirement registry contains generic categories such as legacy trigger writer, legacy cron writer, legacy API writer, and legacy MCP writer rather than exact source/database surfaces.

Entries do not bind repository, frozen commit, path or SQL object, signature, definition digest, owner, grants, callers, live/source state, replacement authority, migration order, rollback, or denial proof.
Generic active=false declarations cannot prove current or legacy writers are actually absent or fenced.
findings.required_correction: Generate exact frozen Engine and backend source inventories; join every writer, resolver, trigger, cron, RPC, API, worker, MCP tool, repair route, rollback writer, compatibility path, and stale-client path to one signed retain/rebuild/retire/research disposition and executable proof.
findings.title: Complete actual-system authority inventory is missing

proof: The registry contains only fifteen commands for the entire whole system.

Several domains are represented by broad placeholders instead of explicit commands and transitions, including location lifecycle, occurrence correction/reopen/next-cycle, notification intent/presentation/ack/supersession/escalation, Event approve/reverse, contractor delivery/accept/reject/complete, retention hold/purge, restore application/reconciliation, and physical acceptance.
CMD-OWNERSHIP-ASSIGN declares aggregate device while referencing SM-OWNERSHIP, demonstrating that cross-domain semantics are not mechanically exact.
findings.required_correction: Create an exhaustive command/record/state-machine taxonomy with explicit aggregate, actor, authorization, expected sequence, transaction, idempotency, failure, recovery, proof, and gate for every normative transition.
findings.title: Command and state-machine coverage is not operationally complete

proof: Coverage is enforced by hard-coded minimum counts and hard-coded expected totals rather than exact domain/source closure.

Attack execution is a set of local toy functions returning expected strings; it does not execute the registries, source inventories, transition tables, producer/consumer graph, or actual failure paths.
The validator trusts the package self-review arrays and self-authored PASS status, creating circular acceptance.
findings.required_correction: Replace count and string simulations with schema validation, exact required-ID coverage, actual inventory joins, model-driven transition execution, direct negative mutations, artifact-digest closure, and a review artifact produced after—not consumed as input to—the primary validator.
findings.title: The deterministic validator can report false green

proof: Most proof rows repeat only deterministic validator plus exact-head content digest, which proves bytes and selected shape—not operational semantics.

Notification and Messenger objects are marked not_applicable_no_physical_effect even though delivery, visibility, wrong-recipient, reconnect, audio, and stale-presentation behavior require runtime or physical evidence.
findings.required_correction: Bind every proof to a named positive, negative, recovery, integration, live, or physical fixture with producer, consumer, exact release/source tuple, expected failure, and invalidation rule.
